text:
Cologne’s median asking rent sits at 15.55 €/m² in June 2026, up 6.1 % year‑on‑year and 28.5 % over the past five years, placing the city fourth among the 37 most expensive German markets. The 25th‑percentile level is 13.16 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 18.5 €/m², while the asking premium over existing rents is 66 % (existing rent 9.39 €/m²).  

The market remains balanced but tight: listings stay on the market only 22 days on average, 36 % are let within a week, and vacancy is just 1.3 %. Rent burden for a two‑person household is 19.5 % and a 60 m² apartment costs about 933 € per month.  

A model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 16.33 €/m² in the next 12 months, with a range of 15.98 – 16.72 €/m², implying a further 5 % rise.
